rules.name: Default or copied test case names
rules.description: Test cases keep names like 'New TestCase' or 'Copy of …', so reports and execution lists don't say what failed.

rules.name: Default test step names
rules.description: Steps named 'New TestStep' or 'Step 3' make logs and failure messages hard to trace.

rules.name: Duplicate test case names in one folder
rules.description: Two test cases with the same name in the same folder can't be told apart in execution lists.

rules.name: Oversized test cases
rules.description: Very long test cases fail late, are slow to debug and usually mix several scenarios.

rules.name: No folder structure inside test cases
rules.description: Tricentis recommends grouping steps into folders such as Precondition, Process, Verification and Postcondition.

rules.name: Duplicated step sequences
rules.description: The same steps are copied into many test cases instead of living in one Reusable TestStepBlock.

rules.name: Hard-coded values inside reusable blocks
rules.description: Reusable TestStepBlocks with fixed input values can only be reused for one data set.

rules.name: Hard-coded environment URLs
rules.description: URLs typed into steps break when the suite moves between environments.

rules.name: Credentials in plain text
rules.description: Passwords and tokens typed as plain values are visible to everyone with workspace access.

rules.name: Repeated literal test data
rules.description: The same data value is typed into many test cases instead of coming from TestCase-Design or a test sheet.

rules.name: Hard-coded dates
rules.description: Fixed dates expire; tests that pass today fail when the date moves into the past or future.

rules.name: Page opened without synchronization
rules.description: After opening a URL or application, the next step acts before the page is confirmed ready.

rules.name: Fixed waits instead of synchronization
rules.description: Hard-coded waits slow every run and still fail when the app is slower than expected.

rules.name: Verify right after a click
rules.description: A Verify that runs immediately after a click can read the old screen before the app has responded.

rules.name: Test cases that never verify
rules.description: A test case without a Verify step passes as long as nothing crashes.

rules.name: Verify with an empty expected value
rules.description: An empty Verify value checks for an empty field, which is rarely what was intended.

rules.name: Disabled steps left in test cases
rules.description: Disabled steps hide real coverage gaps and confuse whoever maintains the test next.

rules.name: No recovery or clean-up scenario
rules.description: Without a recovery scenario, one unexpected dialog fails every following test in the run.

rules.name: Missing test case descriptions
rules.description: Without a description, reviewers can't tell what a test is meant to prove.

rules.name: Test cases not linked to a requirement
rules.description: Unlinked test cases can't be traced to a JIRA or Rally item for coverage and audits.
